blocks.text: You can customize the parameters of the financial model that determines the financial exposure of your organization.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Analytics > Risk360 > Financial Risk > Settings.
The Financial Risk Settings drawer appears.
Under the Default Values, you can view the default values set for your organization during onboarding. To customize these values, under Customized Values:
Industry Vertical: Select the industry vertical that best represents your organization.
Industry Annual Revenue Range: Select the annual revenue range for the organization's industry vertical.

Financial Loss Range: Enter the lower and upper bounds of the financial loss, in case your organization faces a breach. These values are used for simulating financial loss estimations within the set range.
You can click Reset to Default if you want the Risk360 service to use the default values for calculation.

blocks.text: The Financial Risk model inherits the latest values from the preceding settings to perform loss estimations.
